integrity: Analytical orthogonal-block and uniform hypergeometric-limit proof; 174 finite rational/asymptotic checks; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer \(q\ge3\), equal-length equispaced radial rays, uniform arclength probability; no claim for unequal directions, varying density, or perturbative universality. Historical priority provisional, including an incompletely inspected classical Christoffel paper.
title: A multi-Bessel microscopic kernel at equally spaced radial junctions
